title: xcvrd benchmark scenario (v2)
description: A declarative workload. v2 adds the fields needed to carry the B1-B12 suite: a scenario now states WHICH HARNESS can run it (in-process vs live DUT) and whether it is implemented, because roughly half the suite needs a real daemon process, the emulator Monitor stream or supervisord and therefore cannot run in-process. Recording that honestly in the artifact is the point - an unrunnable scenario that looks runnable is worse than an absent one.

ports.description: Number of transceiver slots presented by the mock HAL. Fan-out sweeps vary this.

absent_ports.description: Slot indices reporting get_presence()==false, mirroring unused DUT ports.

fixture.description: Filename under fixtures/, e.g. cmis_40g_lr4.json. Loaded byte-identically by both harnesses.

action.description: Entry point. NOTE: poll_once exists on the Rust DomInfoUpdateTask but has no Python equivalent (Python's sweep is inline in task_worker), so poll_once scenarios need a documented Python shim and must not carry headline numbers. Prefer per-port granularity for direct comparison.

iterations.description: How many times the action is invoked in one trace/measurement.

threads.description: Concurrent tasks. Only threads==1 traces may be compared with --strict-order.

dom_update_interval.description: Seconds; null uses the daemon default (60). Both daemons accept this knob with identical meaning.

excludes.description: Behaviours this scenario must NOT exercise, with justification. Used to keep known-divergent paths (e.g. result_4's deselected link-change fast flag recapture) out of the comparison.

harness.description: inprocess = benchmark/ (mocked plant, throwaway Redis, no daemon process). dut = the live testbed via xcvrd-tests, needed for anything measuring a PROCESS (RSS, threads, SIGTERM) or requiring the emulator Monitor stream. both = implemented in each, measuring the same quantity by different means.

status.description: implemented = runnable now via tools/run_scenario.sh. blocked = defined but not runnable; blocked_by MUST say why.

blocked_by.description: Required when status==blocked. The specific missing capability, not a vague note.

notes.description: Caveats a reader needs in order not to misread the number.

configs.description: Which configs this scenario compares. a=Rust native edge, b=Rust via the real PyO3 bridge, p=the Python daemon.

port_sweep.description: Fan-out sweep values; when present, ports is only the default.
